**Read this aloud before asking any question.**

My name is (say your name). I work with (say your organisation's name) on a KADSIPA programme that supports very poor households in this area.

- Today I would like to ask some questions about who lives in your household and how you live. The answers help decide which households the programme can support.
- Taking part is your choice.
- You can stop at any time or skip any question, even after we start, and you can tell me later that you no longer want your answers used.
- Your answers are kept private. Your household's name is kept with your answers so the programme can find you again, but your answers are never read out at community meetings or shared with your neighbours or leaders.
- Your answers go from this phone to the organisation running this programme, to KADSIPA and to Dimagi, which runs the data system. A programme reviewer who checks a sample of records may also see them.
- Taking part does NOT guarantee that your household will be selected or receive any support. Saying no costs you nothing you would otherwise get.
